caption: The drawing depicts a nature scene featuring several trees with brown trunks and green foliage set against a blue sky. In the foreground, there is a large white stag outlined in reddish-brown with prominent antlers, positioned as if running to the right. Below the stag, three white hounds, each also outlined in reddish-brown, are shown in various running postures, appearing to chase or pursue the stag. The ground is colored in shades of brown and green, with patches of foliage and plants interspersed. The overall composition is horizontal, with the trees forming a loose border at the top and the animals arranged along a horizontal axis at the bottom of the image. There are handwritten numbers and letters below the main scene along the border of the paper.
title: Bandbox Design
